title: What Lies Below
start: Talk to Rat Burgiss south of Varrock.

items.t: 15 chaos runes or 15 pure essence (unnoted, so it's recommended to bring the stackable chaos runes, or store the essence in some pouches)
Access to the chaos altar (requiring any item that acts as the chaos talisman, for example a wicked hood having consumed the talisman, or travelling through the Abyss)

recommended.t: 42 Mining and Enter the Abyss (miniquest) (only if you use the Tunnel of Chaos to get to the chaos altar)
Varrock Teleports would be useful. Teleport tablets may also be used.
Varrock lodestone is very useful as it is just north of Rat Burgiss.

rewards.t: Access to the Tunnel of Chaos, which provides a shortcut to the Chaos altar and the Chaos Tunnels
Ability to speak with Historian Minas in the Varrock Museum and give him the Dagon'hai history book you found during the quest in the Varrock Palace library for 5 kudos.

steps.t: Talk to Rat Burgiss, south-east of the Varrock lodestone by the crossroads to Lumbridge. [Chat: 2 Hello there! › 3 Shall I get them back for you? › Accept]
Immediately west of the Grand Exchange is a camp. Kill 5 outlaws there.
p: Rat Burgiss, by his broken cart.

steps.t: Take all 5 Rat's papers that they drop.
Use the 5 papers on an empty folder.
Talk to Rat Burgiss. [Chat: 2 Hello there!]
Go to the Varrock palace library, and talk to Surok Magis in the most northern room. [Chat: 1 Go on, then!]

sub.t: Optional: search the bookcase south of the telescope in the north-east section of the room for the Dagon'hai History; it can be turned in to Historian Minas after the quest for 5 kudos.

steps.t: Use any method to enter the chaos altar.
With 15 chaos runes, use the wand on the altar.

sub.t: If you brought essence instead, craft the runes now.

steps.t: Give Surok Magis a bowl and the infused wand. [Chat: 1 I have the things you wanted!]
Talk to Rat Burgiss. [Chat: 2 Hello there! › 1 Yes! I have a letter for you.]
Talk to Zaff, in his shop north-west of Varrock Square. [Chat: 4 Rat Burgiss sent me.]
Talk to Surok Magis. [Chat: 1 Bring it on!]
Attack King Roald, and right-click summon with the beacon ring when he has 1 life point remaining.
p: The mind control spell being removed.
Surok tries to escape, but is stopped by Zaff.

steps.t: After the cutscene, return to Rat Burgiss. [Chat: 2 Hello there!]
